summary: 25-year-old man scrambling on the backside of the First Flatiron fell ~20 feet ~10:15 a.m., injuring his lower leg so he could not walk out; passing hikers gave first aid; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and OSMP rangers packaged him into a litter and completed a technical evacuation to the trailhead and a waiting ambulance; evaluated by paramedics and transported to a local hospital. ~4-hour rescue.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; City of Boulder OSMP Rangers; American Medical Response
notes: BCSO case 21-1379. Resolves the run-526 pending dailycoloradonews First Flatiron ~March-2021 date-pin lead.
